FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Global Getaway Travel Agency, we specialize in providing personalized travel planning services for a diverse range of destinations, focusing primarily on leisure travel, corporate retreats, and family vacations. Our operations include comprehensive trip planning, flight and accommodation booking, guided tours, and customer support to ensure a seamless travel experience for our clients. We strive to maintain the highest standards of customer service by utilizing secure, up-to-date booking software and ensuring all employee training includes essential cybersecurity measures. Our agency prioritizes client safety and satisfaction by conducting annual risk assessments of travel destinations, particularly for those that may involve varying levels of risk. By continually reviewing our processes and maintaining relationships with reputable travel providers, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service while adhering to compliance and data protection standards.
